messages:
emily: Quick sync  final announce planned Thu 09:00 PT. Need ENG to confirm: canonical changelog URL, single landing redirect, and explicit canary window. Any infra constraints?
rafa: I'll cut the changelog today. Marketing wants one short URL that redirects to: release-notes, migration-checklist, and webinar anchor. Fine?
chen: Fine. I'll create redirect /release/sep-2024 that anchors to #whats-new, #migrate, #webinar and add a tiny 3-bullet header.
morgan: Canary proposal: 09:00 PT -> 10m canary -> ramp to 50% over 30m -> hold 60m -> full at +2h if no regressions. Rollback triggers: 5xx >0.2% for 5m OR p95 latency up >15%.
emily: Sales asks inbound routing: tag registration with X-Region and utm_campaign. Example payload?
deploy-bot: infra-bot: staging example payload:
```http
POST /api/register
Headers: {"Content-Type": "application/json", "X-Region": "NA", "X-UTM": "sep-release"}
Body: {"email":"pat@example.com","company":"Acme"}
```
rafa: Routing map: NA->sdr-na, EMEA->sdr-emea, APAC->sdr-apac. If >75/day, forward to growth@. I'll add mapping to the runbook.
chen: Docs links (will be live by 17:00 PT): https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/2024-09/redirect -> anchors set.
emily: Marketing needs: 1) two subject lines for A/B (12h) 2) tweet copy 3) 1-paragraph blog header + 2-line migration snippet. Drop drafts here?
rafa: Subjects: A) "Safer rollouts for production LLMs  targeted canaries & migration guides" B) "Cut inference cost and risk with smarter batching + canaries"
morgan: Tweet: "New: smarter batching, KV cache, and targeted canaries to lower inference cost and risk. Read + register: https://events.redwood.ai/sep2024"
chen: Blog header: "We're launching rollout tooling and docs to make production LLMs safer and more cost-efficient. Join our live demo to see canary rollouts in action."
chen: Migration snippet: "1) Pin current model/version before upgrade. 2) Start at 10% traffic; verify p95 and 5xx thresholds, then ramp."
emily: Great. Ops: please schedule canary and set reminders for PD.
deploy-bot: infra-bot: scheduled canary: 2024-09-20T09:00:00-07:00 -> canary_end 09:10, ramp 09:10-09:40, hold until 11:00, full 11:00. PD: eng-oncall -> rafa, eng-sre -> kai. Reminder ping at 08:45 PT.
emily: I'll assemble assets and post final announce doc to #announce by 20:00 PT. Thanks all :rocket:
